clips.title: The story
paras: Driven by grief and vengeance, the hermit Sven Yorgen asks travelers to return to his ruined farmstead in southern Duskwood. While he spent years pursuing the shadowy horsemen who slaughtered his family, a suspicious figure once buried something near his barn that may hold answers.

Sven Yorgen was once a simple farmer working the fields in southeastern Duskwood. His life shattered when hooded Dark Riders riding down from Deadwind Pass attacked his homestead, massacring his family while he was away. Returning to the slaughter, Sven caught sight of an unknown figure skulking near the barn, frantically burying something in the earth. Sven chose vengeance, setting off immediately to hunt down the killers, leaving whatever had been concealed behind.

Now camped in the western hills and consumed by wrath, Sven needs someone to return to the Yorgen Farmstead. Behind an old tree stump sitting between the farmhouse and the ruined barn lies a mound of loose dirt hastily piled together. Recovering whatever is buried there is the first step toward understanding why the shadowy riders targeted a quiet Duskwood farmer in the first place.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something. He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders. So I never discovered what was hidden.
If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful. The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
